1.key: To me, the central input that drives this valuation, the number that I would watch the most is the revenue number.

subs.ko: 제가 보기에 이 값을 움직이는 핵심, 가장 지켜볼 숫자는 매출입니다.
subs.en: To me, the central input that drives this valuation, the number that I would watch the most is the revenue number.

subs.ko: 매출 1조 달러 쪽으로 갈 수 있다면, 나머지는 다 해결됩니다.
subs.en: If I can get towards that trillion dollars in revenues, everything else gets taken care of.

subs.ko: 이익은 따라오고, 컴퓨트 약정도 지킬 수 있고, 자본비용은 낮게 유지되고, 부도 위험은 사라집니다.
subs.en: My profits will come, I'll be able to meet my compute commitments, my cost of capital will stay low, default risk will go away.

subs.ko: 매출이 들어오기 시작하지 않으면, 나머지는 전부 무너집니다.
subs.en: If revenues don't start to come in, everything else falls apart.

4.key: Because I told a big uplifting story about Anthropic, a story where they can get to a trillion dollars in revenues.

subs.ko: 저는 앤트로픽에 대해 크고 희망적인 이야기를 했습니다. 매출 1조 달러까지 갈 수 있다는 이야기요.
subs.en: Because I told a big uplifting story about Anthropic, a story where they can get to a trillion dollars in revenues.

subs.ko: 감을 잡자면, 지금 지구상에 매출이 8,000억 달러를 넘는 회사는 하나도 없습니다.
subs.en: And just for perspective, that would make them the large, there's no other company right now on the face of the earth that makes more than 800 billion revenues.

subs.ko: 가장 가까운 게 아마존과 월마트예요. 저는 앤트로픽에 매출 1조 달러를 준 겁니다.
subs.en: The closest you get is Amazon and Walmart. I'm giving them a trillion dollars in revenues.

7.key: So this is a company that rides almost entirely on, will there be enough of a market for AI products and services or cloud agents around the world

subs.ko: 결국 이 회사는 거의 한 가지에 달려 있습니다. 전 세계에 AI 제품·서비스, 클로드 에이전트를 살 시장이 충분하냐는 거죠.
subs.en: So this is a company that rides almost entirely on, will there be enough of a market for AI products and services or Claude agents around the world

subs.ko: 앞으로 5년 동안 해마다 매출을 두 배로 늘려서, 끝내 매출 1조 달러에 닿을 만큼요.
subs.en: that I could keep doubling my revenues every year for the next five years so I can get to this trillion dollar end revenue.

10.key: Of all the numbers I'll be watching in the financial statements going forward, that's the number that I will focus on because that's the number that drives everything else in the valuation.

subs.ko: 앞으로 재무제표에서 볼 숫자 가운데 제가 집중할 건 그 숫자, 매출입니다. 가치평가의 나머지 전부를 움직이는 숫자니까요.
subs.en: Of all the numbers I'll be watching in the financial statements going forward, that's the number that I will focus on because that's the number that drives everything else in the valuation.

13.key: So I have, you know, my gut feeling is you're going to end up with two, maybe three companies in this space with lots of stickiness in their models.

subs.ko: 제 직감으로는 이 시장에 두세 회사만 남고, 고객이 쉽게 떠나지 못하는 구조가 될 겁니다.
subs.en: So I have, you know, my gut feeling is you're going to end up with two, maybe three companies in this space with lots of stickiness in their models.

subs.ko: 다만 가는 길에 맞닥뜨릴 위험, 판이 뒤집힐 위험이 많습니다.
subs.en: I think there are lots of risks, lots of disruption risks that you have to face along the way.

subs.ko: 제 1조 4,750억 달러를 한마디로 하면, 낙관의 모자를 단단히 쓴 값입니다. 그 모자가 계속 씌워져 있어야 이게 됩니다.
subs.en: So it's the way I would describe the 1.475 trillion is it's my optimist hat is firmly on and you need it to stay on for this to work,

16.key: Let me separate the two issues. One is the compute power commitments are an issue. They're an issue because they're a mismatch.

subs.ko: 두 가지를 나눠 보죠. 하나는 컴퓨트 약정이 문제라는 겁니다. 짝이 맞지 않기 때문이에요.
subs.en: Let me separate the two issues. One is the compute power commitments are an issue. They're an issue because they're a mismatch.

subs.ko: 무슨 뜻이냐면, 젊은 회사, 돈을 못 버는 회사는 돈을 빌리면 안 됩니다. 회사 재무의 첫 번째 원칙이죠.
subs.en: Mismatch in what sense, young companies, companies that are not making money, should not be borrowing money. That's a first corporate finance principle.

subs.ko: 그런데 앤트로픽은 사실상 그 원칙을 어기고 있습니다. 받쳐 줄 이익 없이 계약으로 약속을 했으니까요.
subs.en: And in effect, Anthropic is violating that principle by entering into contractual commitments without the earnings to back it up.

subs.ko: 보통의 젊은 회사라면 이걸로 문을 닫습니다.
subs.en: That'll put most young companies out of business, right?

17.key: There are two things that I think will buffer Anthropic from the risk. The first is after this IPO, their cash balance should be about $200 billion. That's going to cover them.

subs.ko: 앤트로픽을 위험에서 막아 줄 게 있다고 봅니다. 먼저, 상장 뒤 현금이 약 2,000억 달러가 될 겁니다. 그게 버팀목이 되죠.
subs.en: There are two things that I think will buffer Anthropic from the risk. The first is after this IPO, their cash balance should be about $200 billion. That's going to cover them.

subs.ko: 앞으로 2~3년 동안 큰돈이 나가는 곳은 컴퓨트 약정인데, 3년치는 덮입니다.
subs.en: Their big charges for the next two or three years are the compute commitments. They're covered for the next three years.

subs.ko: 숨 쉴 틈은 있습니다. 다만 매출이 아주 빨리 오르기 시작할 때만요.
subs.en: Like there's a breathing room, but it's breathing room only their revenues very quickly start to ramp up,

subs.ko: 10년 안에 1조에 가려면, 적어도 처음 몇 년은 거의 해마다 매출을 두 배로 늘려야 하니까요. 결국 이 둘을 같이 봐야 합니다.
subs.en: because getting to a trillion in 10 years means that you have to be basically doubling revenues pretty much every year, at least in the near term. So this is the combination you're going to be looking at.

19.key: But I can see why they did it. In this business, the AI business, I think compute power is going to become the scarce resource. They were way behind open AI a year ago in terms of compute power lined up.

subs.ko: 그래도 왜 그랬는지는 이해합니다. AI 사업에서는 컴퓨트가 귀한 자원이 될 거예요. 1년 전 앤트로픽은 확보한 컴퓨트에서 오픈AI에 한참 뒤져 있었습니다.
subs.en: But I can see why they did it. In this business, the AI business, I think compute power is going to become the scarce resource. They were way behind OpenAI a year ago in terms of compute power lined up.

19.key: They've caught up and they've gone ahead of open AI with the commitments. So to them, this is their way of saying, we've got a lane set up, so when we grow, we'll have the compute power,

subs.ko: 약정으로 따라잡고 오픈AI를 앞질렀죠. 앤트로픽 입장에선 '자리를 잡아 뒀으니 커질 때 쓸 컴퓨트가 있다'는 겁니다.
subs.en: They've caught up and they've gone ahead of OpenAI with the commitments. So to them, this is their way of saying, we've got a lane set up, so when we grow, we'll have the compute power,

subs.ko: 컴퓨트가 없으면 성장이 와도 감당할 수 없으니까요. 컴퓨트는 귀해질 테고요.
subs.en: because we don't have the compute power. Even if the growth is there, we will not be able to deliver on the growth, because compute power will become scarce.

21.key: Well, we've owned Anthropic since early 23. It's our best performing equity by far in ARKVX, our venture fund.

subs.ko: 저희는 2023년 초부터 앤트로픽을 갖고 있었습니다. 저희 벤처 펀드 ARKVX 에서 단연 가장 성과가 좋은 종목이에요.
subs.en: Well, we've owned Anthropic since early '23. It's our best performing equity by far in ARKVX, our venture fund.

subs.ko: 그래서 아주 꼼꼼히 지켜봐 왔고, 앤트로픽이 기업 시장을 사실상 차지하면서 확신은 시간이 갈수록 커졌습니다. 오픈AI가 아주 빠르게 뒤따랐고요.
subs.en: So we've been watching it very carefully. And our confidence has grown with time as it really took over the enterprise. OpenAI has followed very quickly.

subs.ko: 그래서 여기 대한 저희 확신은 전혀 흔들리지 않았습니다.
subs.en: So our confidence here has not been shaken at all.

subs.ko: 보시다시피 저희는 매일 매매 내역을 공개하는데, 평균 단가를 낮추며 더 사고 있습니다.
subs.en: We are, as you can see, we post our trades every day. So you can see we're averaging down.

22.key: Well, it's very interesting. So you're talking about the Pareto frontier, which is price performance or price given level of intelligence.

subs.ko: 흥미로운 질문인데요. 말씀하신 건 파레토 경계선, 그러니까 값 대비 성능, 같은 지능 수준에서의 가격이죠.
subs.en: Well, it's very interesting. So you're talking about the Pareto frontier, which is price performance or price given level of intelligence.

subs.ko: 저희가 보기엔, 네, 앤트로픽이 '값 대비 성능' 곡선의 맨 앞에 있습니다.
subs.en: And what we're seeing is, yes, Anthropic has the leading edge of the Pareto frontier.

subs.ko: 그 너머를 보면, 곡선의 나머지는 오픈AI가 꽉 잡고 있습니다.
subs.en: If you look beyond that, what you'll find is that OpenAI is dominating the rest of the Pareto frontier,

subs.ko: 기업들이 AI에 쓰는 돈을 더 효율적으로 쓰려는 지금, 이건 정말 중요한 대목입니다.
subs.en: which is really important now that enterprises are thinking about ways to bring more efficiency into their AI spending.

25.key: They would say it's because we ran out of compute power, that we were, you know, that was a combination of open AI underpricing us and compute power becoming a scarce resource.

subs.ko: 앤트로픽은 컴퓨트가 모자랐기 때문이라고 할 겁니다. 오픈AI가 더 싸게 판 데다 컴퓨트가 귀해진 탓이라고요.
subs.en: They would say it's because we ran out of compute power, that we were, you know, that was a combination of OpenAI underpricing us and compute power becoming a scarce resource.

subs.ko: 제 생각엔 둘 다 사실일 수 있습니다. 오픈AI는 앞으로도 계속 더 싸게 팔 거예요.
subs.en: I think the truth is both can be true. OpenAI is going to continue to be that. They keep underpricing.

subs.ko: 그러면 문제가 생깁니다. 그 가격에 맞춰 값을 내려야 하니까요.
subs.en: You're going to have an issue because you're going to have to bring prices down to match their prices.

26.key: And this isn't even opening the door to the other source of competition, which is open source models that are less powerful, but just as effective.

subs.ko: 이건 다른 경쟁자는 꺼내지도 않은 겁니다. 덜 강력하지만 똑같이 쓸 만한 오픈소스 모델들이요.
subs.en: And this isn't even opening the door to the other source of competition, which is open source models that are less powerful, but just as effective.

subs.ko: 대부분의 기업은, AI를 들여와 필요한 일을 하더라도 클로드까지는 필요 없습니다. 과한 거죠.
subs.en: Most businesses don't need Claude, even if they decide to use AI in-house to do what they need to. It's overkill.

subs.ko: 앤트로픽이 배워야 할 것 하나는, 늘 최첨단 모델만 만들지는 않는 겁니다.
subs.en: And I think one of the things Anthropic has to learn is not build frontier models that are essentially state-of-the-art models.

subs.ko: 사람들은 바퀴 넷 달리고 잘 굴러가는 차를 원하는데, 달 수 있는 옵션을 전부 단 차를 만드는 셈이죠.
subs.en: It's like building a car with every single potential add-on. When people just want four wheels and a vehicle that works,

30.key: Because the net effect, what it closes at tomorrow would be the number that I would be comparing my 77 to. The offering price is irrelevant. The opening price is irrelevant. What it ends up tomorrow evening.

subs.ko: 결국 상장 첫날 종가가 제 77달러와 비교할 숫자입니다. 공모가도, 시초가도 상관없어요. 첫날 저녁 어디서 끝나느냐죠.
subs.en: Because the net effect, what it closes at tomorrow would be the number that I would be comparing my 77 to. The offering price is irrelevant. The opening price is irrelevant. What it ends up tomorrow evening.

subs.ko: 첫날 저녁 71~72달러에서 끝나면, 그럴 수도 있는데, 은행들한텐 아주 나쁜 결과지만 저한테는 흥미로워지기 시작합니다.
subs.en: And if it ends up tomorrow evening at 71 or 72, which can happen, that's a really bad outcome for banks, then it starts to get interesting for me.

subs.ko: 그래도 제가 사려면 많이 떨어져야 합니다. 지배구조가 주주에게는 최악으로 짜여 있거든요.
subs.en: But it needs to drop a lot before I buy it because the governance structure is one designed in hell for shareholders.
